entity.name: Mohammed Ashfaq
entity.description: Backend/full-stack developer based in India, maintaining open-source Apache Flink tooling solo alongside full-time employment: a Flink SQL connector for Qdrant (the only one that exists) and an MCP server that lets AI assistants operate Flink clusters via natural language.

projects.name: Apache Flink MCP Server
projects.description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets AI assistants and LLMs interact with Apache Flink clusters through natural language: cluster/job monitoring, metrics, exception tracking, TaskManager resources, and multi-cluster support. No official or well-known MCP server exists for Flink; this fills that gap.

projects.name: flink-connector-qdrant
projects.description: A Flink SQL connector that writes streaming results directly into Qdrant, a widely-used vector database, with no custom DataStream job or hand-rolled client plumbing required. As of this writing, no official or well-known community Flink connector exists for Qdrant; this closes that gap with a proper dynamic table factory.
